title: bench_core.ALIAS's opus row names Opus 5.5 for Claude Code versions before 2.1.280, which the kb says Opus 5.5 requires
goal: A run on the opus alias that reports no model and runs on a Claude Code version before 2.1.280 is priced at the model the kb states for that version, or stops with a named error, rather than at Opus 5.5, which kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md:87 says requires v2.1.280 or later; research the earlier model through /kb-research if the kb lacks it. Found by the SP-7y6dk257 review (plausible, not demonstrated: every pool run reports its model).

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bench_core as bc; r=[since for since, m in bc.ALIAS['opus']]; sys.exit(0 if (0,) not in r or len(r) > 1 else 1)
